title: How to Get Your Home Ready to Sell This Summer | Real Estate Tips That Attract Buyers
description:
🏡✨ Getting your home ready to sell this summer?

In this clip from Episode 7 of the Working Moms Podcast, hosts Gloria Watson and Marisa Barrett, along with surprise guest Crystal Rosales, share expert tips on how to prepare your home for a successful sale during the busy summer market.

We’re diving into what buyers are really looking for — from curb appeal and staging to simple home fixes that make a huge impact. Whether you're planning to list soon or just want to boost your home’s value, this conversation is full of real-world advice.

💡 What You’ll Learn in This Video:
Curb appeal strategies that catch attention
How staging influences buyer decisions
Quick, affordable fixes that help homes sell faster
What turns buyers off (and how to avoid it)
Tips to get your home show-ready now

🎯 Whether you’re a homeowner or a realtor, this clip gives you practical, no-fluff tips to help your listing shine.

🎙️ Watch the full Episode 7 of the Working Moms Podcast for more parenting, home, and real estate insight.
